capture_source: live capture 2026-10-02 (nohat-rfc-working.pcap) frame 5; SAP A4H sysnr=00 via SAP BTP Connectivity Proxy SOCKS5 + Cloud Connector
evidence: CONFIRMED — the gateway accepted this 0x060f frame and the STFC_CONNECTION call round-tripped (ECHOTEXT returned). Proves the gateway-host field [80:192] must carry the SAP system's internal address (here the IPv4 literal 192.168.88.9), not the virtual tunnel host (s4-2025-raw), which an earlier capture showed the gateway rejects with 'hostname ... unknown' (issue #51).
notes: GW_INFO (type 0x060f) — sent by the client after GW_CONNECT accept; the gateway sends no response to this frame.
The server-host block at offset 80 (112 bytes, space-padded) is the field the gateway resolves. gwhost here is the IPv4 literal 192.168.88.9, so no server-side DNS is needed.
Connection handle '56334047' comes from the GW_CONNECT ACK (frame 4).
No credentials appear in this frame (credentials are in the later 0x06cb logon frame, deliberately not captured here).
